palette.primary_role: Header bg, footer bg, trust color (forest/pet green for health, nature, and trust)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons (warm orange/coral — friendly, energetic, treat-like color), key callouts
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (warm cream/off-white), section backgrounds, form fields
palette.neutral_role: Body text (warm brown-gray, softer than pure gray — more natural), secondary info
palette.border_role: Card borders, input borders (soft warm beige, organic feel)

border_radius.sharp: never — avoid sharp corners entirely in pet industry

button_styles.text: Book Appointment, Schedule Visit, Shop Now, Adopt Today, Get Started

button_styles.bg: soft green or cream with border
button_styles.text: Learn More, Meet Our Team, See Services, View Gallery

elevation.approach: Shadows should feel bouncy and light — like a tennis ball. Slightly more pronounced than wedding (more playful) but still friendly.

typical_order: header (warm white or light green bg, logo left with optional paw/mascot, nav center, 'Book Now' pill CTA right, sticky)
hero (full-width happy pet photo or video + warm headline + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA + trust badges)
services (icon + title grid: vet care, grooming, boarding, daycare, training, retail — 3 or 4 columns with rounded cards)
team (photo cards: veterinarian/groomer photo + name + role + bio snippet + pet emoji or favorite animal, warm tone)
gallery (happy pet photo grid, playful captions, soft lightbox, optional Instagram-style layout with rounded images)
reviews (pet owner testimonials: pet photo + owner name + pet name + breed + 5-star review, heartwarming quotes)
appointment_cta (centered, warm bg with paw-print pattern or pet photo, pill buttons, 'Book Your Visit' + phone number, online scheduling widget)
footer (4-column: clinic/store info, services, hours + emergency contacts, social + paw-print decorative touches + copyright)
hero_variants: happy_pet_portrait (Chewy/BarkBox style — adorable pet face full-bleed, warm overlay, playful headline, pill CTA)
vet_clinic_warm (Banfield style — clean clinic photo or illustration, 'Caring for Your Best Friend', professional yet warm)
action_play (Rover/Wag style — pets playing/running photo, energetic, 'Find a Sitter' or 'Book Dog Walking' CTA)
adoption_hero (shelter style — adoptable pet photo + 'Give a Forever Home' + emotional headline, soft, hopeful)
feature_card_variants: service_card (large rounded card: icon + service name + friendly description + 'Learn More' pill link, colorful icon bg)
team_member_card (round photo + name + role + short bio, hover shows fun fact or favorite treat, warm bg)
pet_gallery_card (rounded pet photo + pet name + breed + cute caption, lightbox trigger, Instagram-like)
review_card (pet photo thumbnail + star rating + quote + owner name + pet name + breed, heart icon, warm card bg)

tone_profile.headline_style: warm and welcoming, 4-7 words (e.g., 'Because They're Family.', 'Where Tails Never Stop Wagging.', 'Veterinary Care with Heart.')
tone_profile.cta_style: friendly and encouraging (Book a Visit, Schedule Grooming, Meet Our Team, Shop Treats, Adopt a Friend, Get Started)
anti_patterns: cold/sterile white hospital aesthetic (for vet sites)

color_mood: forest_friendly (#2d5a4b green, #fef9f4 cream, #f4a261 warm orange, #ffffff cards — balanced, veterinary, trustworthy)
sunshine_playful (#e0763b coral, #fff8e7 warm yellow, #3a7c63 green, #ffffff — energetic, daycare/boarding, fun)
berry_sweet (#8b4a6b berry, #fdf5f3 blush, #c49b7c copper, #f5f0e8 cream — grooming salons, boutiques, stylish)
ocean_pup (#4a8fa8 ocean blue, #f7f9fc white, #f4a261 coral accent, #e8f4f8 light blue — coastal/beach vet clinics)
earth_dog (#6b4c3b warm brown, #f5f0e8 cream, #9c7a5e tan, #e8d5c0 sand — natural/organic pet stores, holistic vets)
typography_mood: fredoka_playful (Fredoka headings, Nunito body — rounded, happy, most versatile pet industry font)
nunito_friendly (Nunito for both headings and body — consistent, approachable, clean vet clinics)
baloo_bold (Baloo 2 headings, Quicksand body — extra playful, chunky, great for pet stores and daycares)
layout_density: vet_professional (clean, organized, easy navigation, trust-focused — veterinary clinics and hospitals)
playful_retail (colorful, product-heavy, fun browsing experience — pet stores and subscription boxes)
service_accessible (quick booking visible, services clear, phone prominent — grooming, daycare, walking services)

services_page.best_practices: Clear service categories with icons, transparent pricing (or 'starting at'), specialist credentials, FAQ for common concerns

gallery_page.best_practices: Happy pet photos only, soft rounded images, lightbox gallery, Instagram feed embed, owner consent for all photos
